name: avasan-org
description: Julio's math and computer science teaching homepage
author: Jacob Anderson

scripts.build: npm run -w front-end build && npm run test:static
scripts.build:sites: npm run -w front-end build && npm run test:static && node scripts/build-sites.mjs
scripts.lint-serve: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w front-end serve
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules front-end/node_modules front-end/.nuxt front-end/.output dist
scripts.up: taze major -I && npm run -w front-end up

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: test -x ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged || { echo 'lint-staged is not installed. Run npm install.'; exit 1; }; ./node_modules/.bin/lint-staged
